plans.name: The Colosseum
plans.note: Indoor traditional gym only — barbells, free weights and machines. The site states "No sign-up fees. Cancel anytime." and "No long-term contracts. No hidden fees." — sourced zeros on both fees.

plans.name: The Hive
plans.note: Recovery access only: sauna, cold plunge and red light, with no gym access. The site states "No sign-up fees. Cancel anytime." and "No long-term contracts. No hidden fees." — sourced zeros on both fees.

plans.name: Frontier Pass
plans.note: All three spaces — the outdoor functional gym, The Hive recovery suite and The Colosseum indoor gym — plus community workouts, rucks and monthly gatherings. The site states "No sign-up fees. Cancel anytime." and "No long-term contracts. No hidden fees." — sourced zeros on both fees.
